method: Conservative current-requests capacity, existing placements fixed; first fit descending memory after scarce eligibility. Handles nodeSelectors, required nodeAffinity, NoSchedule/NoExecute taints, extended device capacity. Optimistic: does NOT enforce pod affinity/anti-affinity, PVC availability/access modes, topology spread, host ports, priorities or transient migration overhead. Identifies lost volume copies separately. NOT Kubernetes scheduler simulation nor proof of drain safety. Physical SFF host also loses control plane; no scheduling possible during sole control-plane outage.
